text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Bene!
That was a pleasing armonia.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Matching with Melodia,
I was able to play a beautiful obbligato too!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: The concerto was a huge success!
choice_data_list: Next time, let's go for first place!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, truly...!
The vibrant musicisti's suono
still lingers in the depths of my ears..."

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
The tempo is... allegro.
Still, it might be even more interesting if it were faster.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Look, 1st place is right within reach.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Fufu.
So the obligato intends to swallow up
the melody itself, does it?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"What an ambitious armonia.
Of course, it's a musica that I quite fancy as well."

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Appassionato, a thirst for victory...
For that is the musica at the very core of racing.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
You're right. Next time,
so that I can weave the main melody...
I'll need to polish my skills even further.
